column3: MT 52:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. Close to the Hebrew; “a maskil” is rendered “A Contemplation,” and “the covenant loyalty of God is all the day” “The goodness of God endures continually.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O worker of deceit” is rendered “working deceitfully.”
Close to the Hebrew; “words of swallowing” is rendered “devouring words.”
Close to the Hebrew; מֵאֹהֶל (“from the tent”) is rendered “out of your dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “saying.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָעוּזּוֹ (“his refuge”) is rendered “his strength,” and בְּהַוָּתוֹ (“his destruction”) “his wickedness.”
Close to the Hebrew; רַעֲנָן (“luxuriant”) is rendered “green,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲסִידֶיךָ (“your godly ones”) is rendered “Your saints.”
